issues.desc: CHK-002 records SHA-256 payload digests into the same document it audits (files.modify = docs/requirements/decisions/story-relevance-dynamic-validation-tiers-execution-plan.md, the file CHK-001 creates), but never states a payload boundary. Writing the audit disposition into the audited document changes its bytes, so any recorded digest becomes unrecomputable by a later reader and CHK-002 userSees ("records both payload and response digests") is not independently verifiable. The repository already solved this: story-aware-dynamic-validation-execution-plan.md section 27.6 defines the audited payload as the exact UTF-8 byte prefix before the evidence heading, precisely to avoid a self-referential digest, and embeds a node -e recompute command. State the payload boundary rule and a recompute command in CHK-002 context.

CHK-002 specifies a bespoke Claude/Agy audit protocol without referencing the existing repository-native protocol at story-aware-dynamic-validation-execution-plan.md sections 27.6-27.6.3 (verified present on main: shared audit prompt, pinned invocation forms for both CLIs, response-digest table, and explicit PASS-inadmissibility rules). Two consequences. First, it risks a second divergent audit-evidence format in a Story whose stated purpose is avoiding competing truth sources. Second, 27.6.1 records that "the repository permission hook rejects nested Agy tool calls", so Agy had to receive the exact payload bytes inline in a fresh project; CHK-002 context instead says to record the audit as blocked if either CLI "cannot inspect the frozen payload", which can route the item to a false blocked outcome for a constraint the repository has already worked around. Both CLIs are installed (claude at /opt/homebrew/bin/claude, agy at ~/.local/bin/agy), so this is about protocol conformance, not availability. Cite the section and carry its inline-bytes provision.

Standalone readability: the background gives a circular expansion for one of its two audit tools - "Agy CLI means the local Agy command-line reviewer". A reader with no conversation history still cannot tell what Agy is or who publishes it. The repository already records the identity: story-aware-dynamic-validation-execution-plan.md section 27.6.2 names the auditor "Antigravity Architecture Auditor" at pinned cliVersion 1.1.14. Use a real first-use expansion. (Claude CLI is expanded adequately.)
